answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks by tying voting weight to slashable stake plus a unique-device attestation. Each new identity must lock real capital; if it is caught double-voting, that stake is burned. To reach the zenith of influence an attacker must fund one fresh bond per fake node, so the cost rises linearly with every Sybil. That financial reef makes a large impersonation swarm prohibitively expensive, shielding the honest agent grove.
